name: Zakhauri Theta
source:
Being the oldest one in the group, Zakhauri holds himself responsible of taking care of the others in Kosmos. His life experience has made him pretty chill; however, his dry sense of humor comes off as sarcastic at times. 

Tau is Zak's first priority, even going so far as to build little conveniences just for her. All of his efforts are to help Tau grow and thrive in her own pursuits, as well as keep his heart at ease.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thetaugames/kosmos-connections-0]Kickstarter[/url]]
